limitations: Exact or near-identical concepts may recur across different practice sets when retained as repeated exposure; same-set duplicate and near-duplicate concepts are not allowed.
Six cross-set reinforcement clusters remain informational review signals rather than content defects.
Short-explanation and answer-length heuristics are review signals, not proof of a bad question.
Static Easy/Moderate/Hard labels remain intentionally absent because no authoritative difficulty rubric was supplied.
